page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine operating on the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. The server is driven by a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor, offering 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores via symmetric multiprocessing. Compute resources are coupled with 32 GB of system memory, matching an industry-standard 1:4 CPU-to-memory allocation with 4.0 GB per virtual core. Cache hierarchy includes 48 KB of L1 data cache, 1 MB of L2 cache, and 48 MB of shared L3 cache. Processor instruction sets encompass AVX-512, AVX-512 VNNI, AES-NI, and SHA-NI for vector math and cryptography. Networking delivers a 5 Gbps baseline bandwidth. The configuration bundles no discrete GPUs and provides no local scratch or NVMe storage, requiring network-attached cloud storage.

Performance measurements position the instance squarely within average midrange tiers for general-purpose computing. The processor attains 1,841.19 in stress-ng single-core and 7,764.36 in multi-core metrics, alongside a Geekbench multi-core score of 6,005.0. Memory bandwidth reaches 59.12 GB/s on large uncached read passes and 39.31 GB/s during large block writes. In application benchmarks, the server delivers 7.99 million Redis SET operations per second and 12.01 GB/s throughput for static web serving. While capable of lightweight machine learning tasks, delivering 753.54 prompt tokens per second on small 135M models, performance degrades sharply on 7B models (16.17 prompt tokens per second), highlighting the limits of CPU-only execution.

From an efficiency perspective, the dedicated core architecture and standard memory profile provide stable, predictable capacity without the overhead of unneeded specialized accelerators. Primary operational tradeoffs center on the reliance on remote storage volumes for disk I/O and the absence of hardware acceleration for heavy matrix operations. The ecs.g7.2xlarge is structured for mid-tier web serving, relational databases, cache clusters, continuous integration build nodes, and general enterprise application hosting.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.2xlarge is a general-purpose cloud virtual machine powered by a 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 8 dedicated vCPUs spanning 4 physical cores with multithreading enabled, paired with 32 GB of memory, preserving a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. The instance includes 48 MB of L3 cache alongside instruction support for AVX-512 and cryptographic offloading. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps, while including no integrated local storage or GPU accelerators. In synthetic benchmarking, it registers midrange performance across CPU, memory, and database stress tests, yielding 7.99 million Redis SET operations per second and 12.01 GB/s in static web throughput. Its lack of local NVMe disks requires external block storage for persistent data, and its CPU-only profile is unsuited for heavy deep learning inference. The instance is suited for general enterprise workloads, web serving, microservices, and backend application tiers.
